fixed.explanation: Tracing._captureSnapshot awaits snapshotter.captureSnapshot directly, so a busy page never answers and the 3s budget cannot cut it off. Wrapping the wait in progress.race, as the coverage capture does, lets the budget abort it. The optional chaining hid it from the lint rule, so I also removed it.

query.intent: The tracing snapshotter's DOM snapshot capture, run in the before/after-call hooks of the tracing, awaits the page/frame evaluation directly without tying it to the 3-second progress/budget. It should wrap the snapshot wait in the progress/race (as the coverage capture does) so it is cut off at the budget. The lint rule for untied awaits also misses calls using optional chaining.
query.symptom: With tracing snapshots enabled, calls on a page with a busy main thread never resolve and their explicit timeouts never fire.
